bad_guidance.why: The task is a TEXT contrast failure (12sp bodySmall date at 3.55:1). This record is explicitly about NON-text contrast: 3:1 for controls, borders and focus indicators, and it states hairline dividers at 1.2:1 are acceptable. It never names the 4.5:1 text threshold the task needs. a11y-contrast-text was a candidate for the same concept (0.243 vs 0.251) and lost.

Pre-registered critical concept brand.token_layers is absent from the bundle, as is brand.dark_mode_redesign. The base contains color-semantic-tokens and color-dark-mode-rules (the latter states the 87/60/38% white text steps that is exactly the fix), and `search` ranks them #1-#3 for this sentence, but neither concept was ever demanded, so neither record could enter.

guidance_ignored.why: Non-text/control contrast at 3:1 is not the failing requirement here; the failing pair is 12sp body text at 3.55:1 against a 4.5:1 AA requirement. Following its 3:1 bar literally would have left the defect shipped.

misses.what: a11y.contrast was carried by a11y-nontext-contrast instead of a11y-contrast-text. Both are platform 'any' and both were candidates; the non-text record scored 0.251 vs 0.243, plausibly because it carries a second concept (interaction.focus_visible) and so shows a larger marginal gain. For a text-contrast task the selected carrier is the wrong one.

The sentence says 'in dark mode' and the project is a KNOWN dual-theme Compose app, yet neither brand.dark_mode_redesign nor brand.token_layers was demanded. The whole design answer (fix the semantic token in DarkColors, not the screen) came from reading the code, not from the skill.

inspect_project reported navigation=top-bar KNOWN although the shell is a Material3 NavigationBar (BottomBar.kt, bottom-tabs scored 5); radius=small from 'most common radius 4' although the product's stated card language is CardCornerRadius = 12.dp; spacing=UNKNOWN although Spacing.kt is an explicit 4pt grid; tokens=[] although Color.kt + Theme.kt are a full two-layer token system. On a task whose correct fix lives in the token layer, reporting tokens=[] is the costly one.

regressions.query: In dark mode the transaction dates are barely visible.
regressions.expect: a11y.contrast is carried by a11y-contrast-text (4.5:1 body text), not a11y-nontext-contrast; brand.dark_mode_redesign and brand.token_layers are demanded and carried by color-dark-mode-rules and color-semantic-tokens.

regressions.query: the secondary labels in the dark theme are too dim to read
regressions.expect: bundle contains color-dark-mode-rules; a text-contrast record rather than a control/focus-contrast record.

regressions.query: inspect a Jetpack Compose app whose theme package defines a Color.kt primitive palette and a Theme.kt lightColorScheme/darkColorScheme
regressions.expect: design_context reports a token layer (tokens non-empty) and navigation=bottom-tabs when a NavigationBar is the app shell.
